ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black base; high-intensity white pixel clusters and linear streaks are distributed across both lobes, with a specific high-density concentration of linear marks on the right lobe medial-distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography featuring a series of peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude of 3-15 pixels, showing increased frequency and amplitude on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curve fitted to the posterior boundary from the median notch to the distal lobe apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of high-intensity circular pixels (approx. 2-6 pixels in diameter) localized on the lower central region and near the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and intersecting high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) detected primarily on the right lobe, with minor occurrences on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular erosion and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge and apex of the right lobe compared to the more uniform left lobe tip.
